summary.text: Calm and Steady is an immortal killer move.

claims.text: Fang Yuan stops on a truthful floating ice piece, enduring the vast emotional impact, and activates it. The effect is immediate. The vast and strong emotions crushing him and almost destroying his mental state disappear almost completely. He possesses countless Immortal Gu recipes and just as many killer moves. This killer move is part of them. It requires two main cores, calm Gu and suppression Gu. He does not have calm Gu and cannot refine immortal level calm Gu, but he has fortitude Gu. He had been modifying the killer move while moving, and can use it now. He has suppression Gu. Before the fate war, he fought Heavenly Court in the River of Time and destroyed the river suppression lotus sealing formation, obtaining suppression Gu from it. Suppression Gu is rank eight, and fortitude Gu is also rank eight. With two rank eight cores, the killer move has a stronger effect than fortitude Gu alone. His speed increases again.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable swings Mental Domain toward Fang Yuan. Countless emotions attack his mind and body. He is already prepared and activates several defensive killer moves, including this one. The move was already used in Crazed Demon Cave and has been modified. It suppresses and eliminates his emotions quickly. She does not succeed in disturbing him.

Mental Domain extracts and absorbs Fang Yuan’s accumulated emotions. He immediately uses this killer move, but cannot block the process. Other methods also show no effect. At first only emotions are extracted. Gradually, his wisdom path dao marks are extracted as well.
